@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+name: CI
+
+on:
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - main
+  pull_request:
+
+jobs:
+  test:
+    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / Elixir ${{ matrix.elixir }} / OTP ${{ matrix.otp }}
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
+
+    strategy:
+      fail-fast: false
+      matrix:
+        os:
+          - ubuntu-latest
+          - macos-latest
+        elixir:
+          - "1.17.3"
+        otp:
+          - "27.2"
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+
+      - name: Set up Erlang and Elixir
+        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
+        with:
+          otp-version: ${{ matrix.otp }}
+          elixir-version: ${{ matrix.elixir }}
+
+      - name: Cache Mix dependencies
+        uses: actions/cache@v4
+        with:
+          path: |
+            app/deps
+            app/_build
+          key: ${{ runner.os }}-mix-${{ matrix.elixir }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-${{ hashFiles('app/mix.lock') }}
+          restore-keys: |
+            ${{ runner.os }}-mix-${{ matrix.elixir }}-${{ matrix.otp }}-
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: cd app && mix deps.get
+
+      - name: Run CI
+        run: make ci
+
+      - name: Smoke test escript
+        run: ./app/histlog --help
+
+      - name: Upload escript artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: histlog-${{ matrix.os }}
+          path: app/histlog
+          if-no-files-found: error

@@ -40,7 +40,7 @@ format-check: ## Check Elixir formatting without modifying files.
 lint: ## Run warning-as-error compilation as the repository lint gate.
 	cd app && mix compile --warnings-as-errors
 
-ci: format-check lint test ## Run the local CI gate.
+ci: format-check lint test build ## Run the local CI gate, including escript build.
 
 clean: ## Remove generated output files.
 	rm -rf "$(CLEAN_DIR)"

@@ -4,6 +4,8 @@
 Use this checklist before tagging a public alpha.
 
 * `make ci` passes locally.
+* GitHub Actions passes on Ubuntu and macOS.
+* The CI build uploads the `histlog` escript artifact.
 * `make coverage` runs and the coverage summary is reviewed.
 * `eval "$(histlog init zsh)"` is smoke-tested in an interactive zsh.
 * `eval "$(histlog init bash)"` is smoke-tested in an interactive bash.
